errTitle: Could not read the listening ports
errNoServer: This page needs a server, and none was given.
errNoTool: Neither ss nor netstat is installed, so there is nothing to read the listening sockets with. Install iproute2 or net-tools.
errDenied: This plugin was not given the "{0}" permission. Reinstall it to grant one.
errDeniedPlain: This plugin was not given permission for that.
errUnavailable: This host does not offer what the plugin asked for.
errTimeout: The server did not answer in time.
errIo: The server could not be reached.
errCert: The server's certificate was not the one that was reviewed.
errDecode: The answer could not be read.
emptyDetail: No process on this server holds an open port. That is unusual for a machine reached over SSH — the reading may need an account that can see other users' sockets.
emptyExposedDetail: Everything listening on this server is bound to a local address. Switch to All to see it.
prefsExposed: Show only what is reachable from outside
prefsExposedHint: The filter a page starts with. The button on the page still switches it.
searchHint: Search a port, a process or an address
emptySearchDetail: The search looks at the port, the process name and the bound address.
